narration.text: Detention, lumper and TONU, collected. This is a chore for a three-truck owner-operator carrier hauling for C.H. Robinson, TQL, Uber Freight and a small email-only broker, factored through RTS. Drivers sit at docks on four stops in ten. Athena works it across 6 portals: Motive, Dispatch inbox, C.H. Robinson Navisphere Carrier, TQL Carrier Dashboard, Uber Freight and RTS Pro. On the bench, she found 9 of 9 eligible items, worth 1,580 dollars of the 1,580 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 13 traps, and she walked past 13. Among them: ELD times typed into a CHR request, where the signed BOL's times are the ones checked. A detention request over the rate con's cap. She took 4 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 33 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 30 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
